name: open-design
description: Local-first design app · 139 skills + 150 DESIGN.md systems · exposes projects/files/preview tools to your coding agent over stdio MCP. Requires the `od` daemon on PATH. Connects to http://127.0.0.1:7456 (the `od` default port); set OD_DAEMON_URL to use another daemon, such as one started by tools-dev.
